slides.h1: Why I'm building my app in public.
slides.lead: Posting the wins, the rejections and everything in between.

slides.h2: Shipping is easy. Getting seen is hard.
slides.lead: An app nobody hears about doesn't exist. Posting the journey gives people a reason to look.

slides.h2: Saying it out loud makes you finish it.
slides.lead: It's harder to quietly drop a feature when people are watching you build it.
You're too close to your own product. Fresh eyes are free QA.
By launch day, your followers already know the story.

points: Share what you shipped this week
Post the failures too — rejections included
Show real screens, not just wins
